notes: US version (JUE). ROM is 512KB (0x80000 bytes). Tile format is 4bpp Genesis standard (8x8px, 32 bytes/tile). ROM layout from density analysis: code/compressed 0x200-0x1A000; MAIN SPRITE BANK 0x01B000-0x02A400 (~1952 uncompressed tiles); mixed/compressed 0x02A800-0x052FFF; secondary sprites 0x053000-0x05F400 (~1568 tiles); audio samples 0x05F800+. Palettes at 0x0082DA (MJ gray suit - HIGH confidence), 0x00C770 (fire/explosion animation), 0x002D3C (environment), 0x0033E4 (vivid/cutscene).

sprite_groups.name: MJ - Player Character
sprite_groups.notes: Main player character. Palette 0x0082DA: 16-color gray suit with skin tones. Sprites likely begin at 0x01B000 (large uncompressed sprite bank). Use Raw Tile Browser with 'Main Sprite Bank' range and MJ palette to identify exact tile offsets. Character sprites are typically 2x4 or 3x5 tiles per frame.

palettes.name: MJ Gray Suit Palette
palettes._note: 16 colors: gray gradient (index 0=light to 4=dark gray), gold/skin tones (5-7), more grays (8-11), dark brown (12-13), dark red (14), green (15). Confidence: HIGH - grayscale + skin tone pattern is characteristic of MJ's gray suit sprites.

palettes.name: MJ Walk - Alternate Palette
palettes._note: Vivid: orange-gold (0-2), teal (3-5), pure colors (6-8: green/red/cyan). May be special move or cutscene palette. Confidence: MEDIUM.

sprites.name: MJ walk frame (TBD - scan from 0x01B000)
sprites.notes: Starting point for Main Sprite Bank scan. Browse the tile range 0x01B000-0x02A400 in Raw Tile Browser with 'MJ Gray Suit Palette' to identify walk frames. MJ is typically 2x4 or 3x5 tiles. Use jump-to-offset to navigate.

sprites.name: Sphere/gem tile (DMA source 0x032D8A)
sprites.notes: 0x032D8A found as DMA source address. Tile shows circular gradient (sphere outline). Surrounding tiles look like coins/gems/UI elements. CAUTION: this region has density ~1.0 suggesting it may be Nemesis-compressed, not raw 4bpp.

sprite_groups.name: Environment / Level Tiles
sprite_groups.notes: Level backgrounds and platform tiles. The secondary sprite bank at 0x053000-0x05F400 likely contains level tilesets. Use 'Earth Tones' palette for scanning.

palettes.name: Earth Tones / Environment
palettes._note: Salmon/pink, browns, and blues. Possibly level background palette. Confidence: MEDIUM.

palettes.name: Fire/Explosion Palette (animated)
palettes._note: 4-palette rotating block (128 bytes). All orange-red. Animation palette cycling. Confidence: HIGH.

sprites.name: Level tile at 0x05A000 (scan target)
sprites.notes: Start of secondary sprite/tile bank. Density 0.42-0.56 throughout 0x05A000-0x05F400 (704 tiles). Likely level/BG tilesets or additional character sprites.

tile_ranges.label: Header + Early Code (0x200-0x15000)
tile_ranges._note: ROM header, vectors, and main game code. Palettes stored here: MJ suit at 0x0082DA, environment at 0x002D3C, vivid at 0x0033E4. Not useful for tile browsing.

tile_ranges.label: MAIN SPRITE BANK - MJ + enemies (0x01B000-0x02A400)
tile_ranges._note: PRIMARY candidate for character sprites. Density analysis: ~1952 tiles, consistently moderate density 0.37-0.65 (sprite-like). Use MJ Gray Suit palette. Look for 2x4 or 3x5 tile character frames near the start. This is the largest uncompressed sprite-like region in the ROM.

tile_ranges.label: Secondary sprites / level tiles (0x053000-0x05F400)
tile_ranges._note: ~1568 tiles. Density 0.28-0.65, sprite-like throughout. May contain level tilesets, item sprites, enemy tiles. Scan with Earth Tones palette.

tile_ranges.label: Full ROM scan (0x200-0x5F400)
tile_ranges._note: Full scan. NOTE: 256KB limit in app means only first 256KB shown at once. Use jump-to-offset to navigate to 0x01B000 or 0x05A000.
